title: Multi-audience token hands both consumers the same sub, defeating pseudonymity
description:
One JWT-SVID bearing two audiences gives both relying parties the same `sub`, which is a cross-consumer correlation handle. SPEC-HIRE.md:83 says a consumer 'cannot correlate with any other consumer's identifier' and PRFAQ.md:16 repeats the guarantee; SPEC-HIRE.md:94 says presenting a specific audience triggers derivation of that consumer's pseudonym.

NOT LIVE: hire-grpc/src/service.rs signs `claim.spiffe_id()`, not a pseudonym, so no pseudonym is being leaked today. This becomes real the moment per-consumer pseudonym derivation (SPEC-HIRE.md:94) lands, at which point a single token cannot carry two `sub` values and multi-audience must collapse to one audience per request.

Belongs with the pseudonym-derivation work, not with the presence gate. Spotted while fixing persona-5s4b.47.
